newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis to appoint acting chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis to appoint acting chief.

text.p: Australis Media Ltd would announce on Wednesday new managerial appointments after the confirmation that its managing director Neil Gamble was joining Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd, Gamble said.
Gamble said at a news conference where it was announced he would be appointed chief executive officer of the casino group, that Australis would appoint Larry Carlton as acting chief executive.
Carlton joined Australis earlier this year from one the satellite pay television operator's equity parters, Tele-Communications Inc, a U.S. cable TV group.

Australis confirmed in a statement that it would appoint Carleton, the current chief operating officer, as interim chief executive officer to replace Gamble, who was managing director of Australis since October 1993.
Australis chairman Rodney Price said in a statement the joint venture with Optus Vision was likely to require further organisational changes over the next several months.
On October 4, Optus and Australis formed a Direct To Home (DTH) satellite pay TV venture, which would see the two groups pooling their respective technical facilities together.
Gamble said Australis had known for two months that he would be leaving the company.
He said his time at Australis was sometimes dfficult as it was a start-up venture in a competitive environment.

Gamble said he thought Australis' future was now clear with the recapitalisation about to be put in place. Earlier this month, Australis' bond holders approved a recapitalisation of the struggling pay TV group.
